name: storm-deepresearch-skill
description: Governed STORM research harness with tasklets, findings pool, receipt chains, evidence ledgers, validated Markdown/HTML/PDF, and trust-approved release.
author: 陈旭
input_files: User files or URLs, retrieval records, STORM findings, absence-search records, external review provenance, trust evidence, and human approval records.
output_contract: Workspace run with generation artifacts, tasklets, findings pool, receipt chain, evidence ledgers, captured external review, Markdown/HTML/full PDF, validation, and allowlisted release.
rollback_boundary: Restore the archived 2.0.0 package for 2.x runs; 3.0 runs and retrieval audits remain external and are not downgraded.
trust_requirement: Release requires Yao Trust, registry hash match, validation receipt binding, and human approval.
